name: Amber Sacre
researchKeywords: healthcare access, vaccination, healthcare services research
bio: As a mixed methods researcher specialising in health inequalities, Amber brings a comprehensive and interdisciplinary approach to understanding the complex factors contributing to disparities in health experiences and outcomes.
researchFocus: While Amber's research explores various different aspects of health inequalities, her focus is socioeconomic inequalities in healthcare access and uptake.

researchActivity.projectTitle: Shifting healthcare services from hospitals to community settings: Implications for health inequalities – A systematic scoping review
researchActivity.summary: We conduct a systematic scoping review to ascertain which non-urgent hospital-based healthcare services can be shifted to community settings, and to understand the impact of these shifts on health inequalities.

professionalRoles.title: Researcher
professionalRoles.organisation: Deep End North East North Cumbria Research Team
